scope: Original 26 graph contracts; view references do not prove live data, provider coverage or physical-device behaviour.

graphs.title: Reporting audience over time
graphs.definition: Distinct reporting active installations per day; new means first retained observation. Never sum daily distincts into monthly distincts.
graphs.drilldown: Return to days and permitted device records.
graphs.limitation: Cleared storage, opt-out and missing days bias audience; no global unique-child count.

graphs.title: Reported profiles and device mix
graphs.definition: Count reporting installation/profile pairs and distinct installations separately; group device/OS/browser and age band. Approximate online presence uses the current 5-minute freshness window, not permanent live status.
graphs.drilldown: Open selected device group then an authorised device.
graphs.limitation: Profiles are not globally deduplicated children. Name reporting can be off.

graphs.title: New and returning reporting installations
graphs.definition: New: first retained active day in window. Returning: active earlier in retained history. Exact-day D7 uses only matured cohorts and is a separate proposed metric.
graphs.drilldown: Open cohort definition and permissible records.
graphs.limitation: Retention job, rollups and mature cohort reporting remain work; not all historical first-ever dates are known.

graphs.title: Reported play pattern
graphs.definition: Sum reported minutes per device-local hour/day; label timezone basis. Profile participation minutes may overlap in shared play.
graphs.drilldown: Open selected day and activity summary.
graphs.limitation: Reported active play is not total screen time; no precise minute-by-minute timeline from daily buckets.

graphs.title: Website engagement
graphs.definition: Page views, Play clicks and reported active seconds shown as separate event series. Clicks/views is an event ratio, not person conversion.
graphs.drilldown: Open route/language/device aggregate.
graphs.limitation: Best-effort dropped requests and opt-out; no unique visitor or session linkage.

graphs.title: Website-to-play connection
graphs.definition: Current website views/clicks and game boot observations are separate panels. Matched funnel only after L13 exists, with eligible handoff denominator and pending/expired outcomes.
graphs.drilldown: Inspect stage definition and current gap.
graphs.limitation: No numerical conversion arrow between unmatched populations; no cross-device attribution.

graphs.title: Activity popularity
graphs.definition: Game starts per kind:id where available; story opens historically aggregate, named story attempts only from detailed events.
graphs.drilldown: Open one game/story editor with evidence.
graphs.limitation: A popular activity is not proof of learning benefit or quality.

graphs.title: Activity outcomes
graphs.definition: Detailed attempts: completed/abandoned/pending/unknown/inconsistent within same start cohort. Legacy participation ratios kept separately.
graphs.drilldown: Open outcome definition and anonymous attempt evidence; names need detail permission.
graphs.limitation: Do not mix attempt and profile-participation denominators; no causal difficulty claim.

graphs.title: Built-in story journeys
graphs.definition: Match built-in opened/completed events by device+attemptId+storyId; pending/unknown separate. Completion follows actual instrumented final-page condition.
graphs.drilldown: Open story and recording/review details.
graphs.limitation: Earlier aggregate opens cannot be backfilled into per-story completion.

graphs.title: Startup experience
graphs.definition: Split legacy capped startup samples from reportable boot attempts. For proposed p95 use matched ready-start nearest-rank distribution, show n; no directional status below 20.
graphs.drilldown: Open build/device cohort and startup-stage evidence.
graphs.limitation: Failures before instrumentation invisible; first picture and first playable are different measures. p95 chart requires validated rollup implementation.

graphs.title: Smoothness and reported errors
graphs.definition: Weighted FPS=sum samples/count; low-FPS count/count; error-affected distinct active devices/active devices.
graphs.drilldown: Open selected build/device and problem evidence.
graphs.limitation: Low FPS <20 at current legacy threshold; stuck detection is not a confirmed defect.

graphs.title: Measured battery behaviour
graphs.definition: Battery percentage-point loss / measured battery hours; active drawing FPS excludes idle and unmeasured intervals.
graphs.drilldown: Inspect supported samples and measurement definitions.
graphs.limitation: Many browsers cannot measure battery; not watts, monetary energy cost or all-device battery performance.

graphs.title: Reported connection outcomes
graphs.definition: Success / eligible matched connection-attempt starts; pending/unknown remain in denominator; direct/relay split.
graphs.drilldown: Inspect outcome codes without room codes or media.
graphs.limitation: Current hooks cover guest join; host/reconnect coverage incomplete.

graphs.title: Voice playback evidence
graphs.definition: Current recorded success rate: confirmed successes / confirmed success-or-failure observations; cancelled/unknown shown separately, not hidden in denominator.
graphs.drilldown: Open affected asset context where safely known.
graphs.limitation: Browser playback completion is not proof of audibility; no speech content collection. Current wire event is voice.result, not legacy proposal voice.playback/result.

graphs.title: Content and website review coverage
graphs.definition: Rows=kind:id; columns EN/VI metadata, implementation, reviewed guide source and recording audit. Counts use explicit required-item inventory.
graphs.drilldown: Open missing item and reviewer action.
graphs.limitation: Catalogue recordings currently not-audited. Anchor exists does not mean source alignment; missing review is not complete coverage.

graphs.title: Release adoption
graphs.definition: Observed sender-build distribution across distinct reporting devices; daily-originating build separately labelled.
graphs.drilldown: Open version cohort and review evidence.
graphs.limitation: Sender build is not all gameplay within a retained bucket; no claim about non-reporting installs.

graphs.title: Configuration delivery
graphs.definition: Exact revision/hash applied receipts / fixed eligible reporting cohort saved with change; rejected/unsupported/unconfirmed separate; later/new devices shown outside cohort.
graphs.drilldown: Open revision → eligible devices → available permitted receipt.
graphs.limitation: Actual current service counts exact revision/hash; do not use historical metric wording that credits arbitrary later revisions. Device clock skew can invalidate delay.

graphs.title: Problems and recovery
graphs.definition: New/open/verified work by date, unique reporting devices by issue/build; proposed verified recovery duration=verifiedAt-firstReportAt for qualified cases.
graphs.drilldown: Open original report plus separate follow-up and verification.
graphs.limitation: Observed report rate is not total defect incidence; confirmed regression and recovery charts need validated classification/time fields.

graphs.title: Jobs and service readiness
graphs.definition: Terminal successful eligible provider runs / terminal eligible observed runs; queued/running/unknown separate. Quota forecast only matching real provider window/usage.
graphs.drilldown: Open provider observation, run or durable operation.
graphs.limitation: Provider credentials/feeds may be absent/stale. Do not invent quotas or convert dispatch accepted into success.

graphs.title: Recorded cost trend
graphs.definition: Eligible nonvoid expense/credit original minor units allocated by service days, converted explicitly; cash view uses paidAt UTC date separately.
graphs.drilldown: Open category → invoice line → immutable history.
graphs.limitation: Current manual-ledger coverage must be visible; missing FX means unavailable comparable totals, not zero.

graphs.title: Budget and commitments
graphs.definition: Budget minus recognised actual expense minus remaining separately reserved commitments; link settlements to avoid double counting.
graphs.drilldown: Open budget, commitment and linked actuals.
graphs.limitation: Estimates are distinct; credits and commitment settlement must pass service constraints.

graphs.title: Recorded cash and upcoming obligations
graphs.definition: Cash trend from paidAt records only. A true due-date schedule is proposed and requires explicit dueAt/settlement data; existing commitments alone do not prove due dates.
graphs.drilldown: Open payment-status evidence or obligation.
graphs.limitation: No bank balance, live payment verification or bank-payment action. A missing dueAt cannot become overdue.

graphs.title: Qualified operating forecast
graphs.definition: Use fixed commitments plus variable actual-to-date plus remaining days times trailing 7 complete-day variable mean, only when required coverage is asserted.
graphs.drilldown: Open basis, covered dates and assumptions.
graphs.limitation: Forecast is an estimate, not cash runway. Band must have an explicit method before numeric uncertainty limits are shown.

graphs.title: Cost per reporting activity
graphs.definition: Comparable operating cost / reporting active installations; cost / (reported minutes/60). Show period, currency, coverage and actual denominator.
graphs.drilldown: Open invoice numerator and reporting usage denominator subject to permissions.
graphs.limitation: Not cost per unique child/customer; more complete analytics can change the ratio without a true cost change.

graphs.title: Revenue and contribution
graphs.definition: Recognised eligible revenue - refunds - payment fees - explicitly attributed variable costs, using documented allocation; require approved revenue definition.
graphs.drilldown: Open each contributing record and allocation.
graphs.limitation: Deferred until revenue/attribution policy and sufficient records exist; no assumed monetisation of children.

graphs.title: Update and backup observations
graphs.definition: Count update.result and backup.result by operation/outcome; initiated/cancelled/failed/succeeded separate. No reuse of boot-readiness formula for this chart.
graphs.drilldown: Inspect safe reason codes and relevant device if authorised.
graphs.limitation: Browser export completion does not prove durable off-device backup or restore recoverability.
